decisions.reason: As a flagship, close-to-core digital module that supports the firm's main software and strategic direction, it is likely to meet aspirations or be protected by organisational slack.
The education institute extends existing training capabilities and customer relationships, so a growing firm with slack is more likely to retain it unless results clearly disappoint.
A remote support tool is tightly linked to the firm's service model and likely inexpensive to maintain, which makes retention more likely than withdrawal.
Practice analytics fits the firm's move toward more digital and efficient practice management, so management would likely continue it while learning about demand.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and should strengthen the core business, making it unlikely to be dropped soon.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the core software business, so if its results fall short of aspirations management is likely to reallocate resources back to core products and new development.
